row:
Gawler Animal Hospital isn’t just a vet clinic, it’s a place where pets and people feel at home. We care for everything from the simple stuff, like vaccinations and check-ups, to the tricky things, like complex medical cases and surgery.
We’re a local team, but our patients come from near and far, because what we do is a bit different. We believe that vet visits should'nt be stressful. That’s why we’ve built a ‘fear-free’ environment where tails wag, cats feel safe, and everyone, two-legged and four, can relax.
Our promise is simple: to treat every pet as if they were our own, and every owner as we’d want to be treated. It’s not just about medicine, it’s about kindness, trust, and making sure your best friend gets the care they deserve.

Visit our website: www.gawlervets.com.au 
Call us: 85223500 
Email us: reception@gawlervets.com.au
